reproduction_scope: Synthetic wrapper observability defect only. No remote native failure reproduction or causal claim.

prior_assertions_passed: reported terminal receipt counts exactly 100 tokens once

proposed_minimal_helper_change: Construct one Capture-owned callback for each reserved call ID. Pass it as usage_checkpoint to the actual injected NativeProcessorRunner constructor.
Keep the latest sanitized snapshot in receipts/call-NNNN-checkpoint.json, version native-usage-checkpoint-v1. Do not append checkpoint rows to calls.jsonl.

Allow only current call identity, validated worker thread/turn IDs, bounded duration_ms and usage status/source/updates/six token counters. Drop unknown keys and raw strings. Keep null tokens when unavailable. Never copy arbitrary errors, prompts, URLs, configuration, or nested values.

Write a bounded replacement snapshot atomically with file fsync and directory fsync. NativeProcessorRunner already bounds callback frequency and tolerates callback failure. Do not change native outcome if telemetry storage fails.

Leave terminal success/failure metrics authoritative. Checkpoint reported/partial status does not change usage(), reuse eligibility, budget reservations, report totals, unresolved status, or unknown-usage stop.
Do not add episode-processor callback API. The injected runner currently receives only the request, so helper-only forwarding does not restore incremental episode SQLite checkpoints.
next_vertical_controls_after_release: Malformed checkpoint keys/IDs/usage cannot retain raw sentinel or malformed values; no synthetic zero for absent usage.
A reported checkpoint followed by unknown terminal metrics still leaves totals null.
Repeated checkpoints replace one bounded artifact, leave exactly one start and terminal row, and do not create cache/reuse eligibility.
Storage callback failure does not mask successful result or original safe failure.

failure_tuple.reason: NativeProcessorRunner exposes safe mapped reason plus metrics and worker IDs, but discards the original error tag/status. Helper-only code cannot recover it. No failing case justifies broad telemetry now. A separate prospective processor change would require root approval and a bounded sanitization test. No raw error text.

future_summary_contract_suggestion.owner: parent, sequential helper mutation only after this patch ends
future_summary_contract_suggestion.minimal_behavior: Under the new opt-in, collect each physical shared generation receipt once, even when independent_generation is false. Include failed shared generation in pipeline_failures. Keep legacy output unchanged without opt-in.
future_summary_contract_suggestion.identity: Use actual execution variant/history/stage=generation/status from saved generation.json; identify shared generation runtime separately rather than relabel baseline execution as candidate.
future_summary_contract_suggestion.missing_stage: When absent, show missing only for required physical shared generation executions from the selected protocol. Do not duplicate one shared execution across both arms.
future_summary_contract_suggestion.controls: Synthetic failed shared generation appears once; complete shared generation adds no failure; missing required stage remains distinct; independent mode and legacy output unchanged. No retry, grade, token-total, or gate promotion.
